title: Open Food Facts MCP
description: Provide your own monitored contact email before starting this MCP server. For Standby, save it in your private task and enable passing task input to Standby runs.

contactEmail.title: Your contact email
contactEmail.description: Enter your own monitored email address. It is stored in the Apify task/run input and sent to Open Food Facts in the User-Agent header for your requests. No shared developer address is used. Maximum 160 ASCII characters.
